scenarioNames: A responder cannot resolve an incident
An assigned commander can resolve a monitored incident
An observer cannot be assigned operational response duties
A school viewer cannot change system data
An observer can review an incident without an assignment
Completed work accepts durable HTTPS evidence
A deprecated service cannot receive a new incident
The open queue excludes closed and cancelled incidents
Only an explicit final marker removes the next-update requirement
limitations: These scenarios make selected core reliability rules readable and executable; they do not replace API, D1, browser, security, or external-user testing.
The suite intentionally covers a risk-selected subset. Gherkin quantity and a passing result are not a quality score.
The step definitions and product code are in the same repository, so this is not an independent holdout or third-party oracle.
